nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: TESTING MODE: every 5 minutes. This one trigger now drives BOTH halves - it keeps the MCP server alive AND runs the scraper. Run either this trigger or the repo's own schedule (crontab.txt / `npm run cron`), never both, or every symbol gets queried twice.

nodes.name: Called By Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Optional entry point, kept so another workflow can still call this one. The supervisor half is now inline, so nothing external has to start the MCP server first.

parameters.command:
set -e
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/screener-mcp-server
REPO=https://github.com/shivamg194-lab/screener-mcp-server.git
TARBALL=https://codeload.github.com/shivamg194-lab/screener-mcp-server/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

# --- fetch or update the repo (git if present, tarball fallback) ---
if [ -d "$DIR/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$DIR" pull --ff-only || true
elif command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git clone --depth 1 "$REPO" "$DIR"
else
  echo 'git not found in container, falling back to tarball'
  mkdir -p "$DIR"
  wget -qO- "$TARBALL" | tar xz --strip-components=1 -C "$DIR"
fi

cd "$DIR"

# --- install deps INCLUDING devDependencies ---
# The n8n image sets NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm skip devDeps and
# leaves typescript missing, so the build would fail. Force it here.
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  NODE_ENV=development npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund \
    || NODE_ENV=development npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
else
  NODE_ENV=development npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
fi

# --- build (call tsc directly; `npm run build` also runs chmod) ---
./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json

test -f dist/index.js || { echo 'BUILD_FAILED: dist/index.js missing'; exit 1; }
echo "BUILD_OK node=$(node -v) dir=$DIR"

nodes.name: Build MCP Server
nodes.notes: screener-mcp-server: fetch/clone (tarball fallback when the image has no git), npm install with devDependencies forced on, then tsc. Prints BUILD_OK.

parameters.command:
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/screener-mcp-server
PORT=3123
LOG=/home/node/.n8n/screener-mcp.log
PROBE='{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

# --- already listening? then do nothing (idempotent restart-safe) ---
if wget -q -O /dev/null --timeout=3 \
     --header='Content-Type: application/json' \
     --header='Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
     --post-data="$PROBE" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ALREADY_RUNNING port=$PORT"
  exit 0
fi

cd "$DIR"
# Detach so the process outlives this node's execution. It still dies if the
# n8n container restarts - that is what the 10-minute schedule is for.
if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  TRANSPORT=http PORT=$PORT setsid node dist/index.js >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
else
  ( TRANSPORT=http PORT=$PORT nohup node dist/index.js >> "$LOG" 2>&1 & )
fi

sleep 3
echo "STARTED port=$PORT log=$LOG"
tail -n 5 "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || true

nodes.name: Start If Not Running
nodes.notes: Idempotent: probes tools/list first and exits ALREADY_RUNNING if the server is already listening on 3123, so a 5-minute tick does not spawn duplicates.

nodes.name: Report Healthy
nodes.notes: MCP server confirmed up. Only from here does the scraper half run, so it can never query a dead endpoint.

nodes.name: Dump Log On Failure
nodes.notes: MCP server never came up - the scraper half is skipped entirely this tick.

parameters.command:
set -e
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/cron_scrapper
REPO=https://github.com/Tengenisu/cron_scrapper.git
BRANCH=main
TARBALL=https://codeload.github.com/Tengenisu/cron_scrapper/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

# --- auth ---
# This repo is private: anonymous requests to both the API and codeload get a
# 404, and git would then block forever on a username prompt. Fail fast instead,
# and pass GITHUB_TOKEN per command so it never lands in .git/config on the
# n8n volume. Set it in docker-compose (environment: - GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_...).
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
export GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/true
if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
  B64=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')
  echo 'auth: using GITHUB_TOKEN'
else
  B64=''
  echo 'auth: none (repo must be public)'
fi
git_run() {
  if [ -n "$B64" ]; then
    git -c http.extraHeader="Authorization: Basic $B64" "$@"
  else
    git "$@"
  fi
}

# --- fetch or update the repo (git if present, tarball fallback) ---
# fetch + reset --hard, NOT pull --ff-only: a shallow clone with no upstream
# tracking makes pull die with "Cannot fast-forward to multiple branches", and
# with a trailing "|| true" that failure is silent - the container then quietly
# runs a stale checkout forever. This form always lands exactly on origin/main,
# and says out loud which commit it is running.
if [ -d "$DIR/.git" ]; then
  if git_run -C "$DIR" fetch --depth 1 origin "$BRANCH" && git_run -C "$DIR" reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH"; then
    echo "SYNC_OK $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD) on $BRANCH"
  else
    echo "SYNC_WARN: could not update $DIR - running whatever is already checked out"
  fi
elif command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git_run clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" "$REPO" "$DIR"
else
  echo 'git not found in container, falling back to tarball'
  mkdir -p "$DIR"
  if [ -n "$B64" ]; then
    wget -qO- --header="Authorization: Basic $B64" "$TARBALL" | tar xz --strip-components=1 -C "$DIR"
  else
    wget -qO- "$TARBALL" | tar xz --strip-components=1 -C "$DIR"
  fi
fi

cd "$DIR"

# --- install deps INCLUDING devDependencies ---
# The n8n image sets NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm skip devDeps and
# leaves typescript missing, so the build would fail. Force it here.
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  NODE_ENV=development npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund \
    || NODE_ENV=development npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
else
  NODE_ENV=development npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
fi

# --- build (call tsc directly, same as the supervisor does) ---
./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json

test -f dist/index.js || { echo 'BUILD_FAILED: dist/index.js missing'; exit 1; }
echo "BUILD_OK node=$(node -v) dir=$DIR"

nodes.name: Build Scraper
nodes.notes: cron_scrapper: fetch + reset --hard onto origin/main (private repo - set GITHUB_TOKEN in docker-compose; tarball fallback when the image has no git), npm install with devDependencies forced on, then tsc. Prints SYNC_OK <sha> so you can see which commit is actually running.

parameters.command:
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/cron_scrapper
OUT=/tmp/earnings-scraper.out
ERR=/tmp/earnings-scraper.err

# Hard ceiling on this node, so it can never run into the next tick. The scraper
# has its own RUN_DEADLINE_MS (4 min) and normally returns a partial snapshot
# well before this fires; if it doesn't, the process is killed.
LIMIT=${SCRAPER_TIMEOUT:-330}

# Always exit 0 with exactly one JSON document on stdout - the next node has to
# have something parseable no matter what went wrong here.
fail() { printf '{"ok":false,"error":"%s"}\n' "$1"; exit 0; }

cd "$DIR" 2>/dev/null || fail "cron_scrapper is not checked out - the build step failed"
test -f dist/index.js || fail "dist/index.js missing - the build step failed"

# TESTING MODE: nothing is cached, so every tick regenerates its data.
export CACHE_ENABLED=0
export MCP_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:3123/mcp
export DATA_DIR="$DIR/data"
export RUN_DEADLINE_MS=240000
export LOG_LEVEL=info

if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  timeout -k 10 "$LIMIT" node dist/index.js --once > "$OUT" 2> "$ERR"
else
  node dist/index.js --once > "$OUT" 2> "$ERR"
fi
RC=$?

# The log tail is what tells you WHERE a slow pass went - always surface it.
tail -n 60 "$ERR" >&2

if [ "$RC" = "124" ] || [ "$RC" = "137" ]; then
  fail "scraper hit the ${LIMIT}s hard timeout - the MCP server is slow or down"
fi
test -s "$OUT" || fail "scraper printed nothing (exit $RC) - see the log above"

cat "$OUT"

nodes.name: Run Scraper
nodes.notes: node dist/index.js --once: scan Moneycontrol for stocks with results, resolve each to an NSE symbol or BSE code, dump that symbol from the MCP server, format it, print one JSON document. A cold pass takes ~2.5 min; RUN_DEADLINE_MS caps the MCP step at 4 min (stocks not reached come back with status 'pending') and `timeout` kills the process at 330s, so this node can never run into the next tick.

nodes.name: Parse Scraper JSON
nodes.notes: stdout -> JSON, with the tail of stderr kept under `log` for debugging.

nodes.name: Fresh Data?
nodes.notes: A real snapshot goes left; a skipped tick or an error goes right.

nodes.name: Split Into Companies
nodes.notes: One item per stock, each carrying its formatted MCP data under `data` and a status of ok / pending / failed / unresolved. Nothing Moneycontrol reports about the company is included — it is the scan only.

nodes.name: Skipped Or Failed
nodes.notes: An overlapping tick ({"ok": true, "skipped": true}) is normal, not an error. A build failure, a scrape failure or the hard timeout lands here too.
